hidden flag (lets say its a hole) and it will not show as "a hole is here"
but they will be able to do things with it such as get things out of it
(assuming you made it a container).

Fixing a typo can be tedious if you had to retype entire room descriptions
each time, so this provides a simple way in which to fix those nasty typos.
You MUST seperate the search and replace strings with slashes (/) and you
MUST not put any spaces in there unless you want them to be part of the
search or replace string.  For instance "red fix /boot / book" will search
for the exact string "boot " (with a space) and replace it with the exact
string " book" (with a space.)  As this is probably not your intention, be
sure to put only an EXACT literal search string for each part of the command.
This will replace every occurance of the search string in your room description
with the replacement string.  There is currently no way to fix extras.

Examples:
    red fix /cat/dog    [Replace all occurences of cat with dog]
    red fix /the/The    [Capitalize all "the"s in your description]

Input a "name" or title for a specific room.  This title will appear
above the room description when someone walks in.  Room names should

Rivers have current, and this allows you to set the speed and direction in
which it flows.  Generally, use this only if the sector type (see RED_SECTOR)
is "Water NoSwim".  Direction is which exit the current will carry you, and
speed is the duration in ticks (1/4 second) before it moves.  Setting speed
to 0 will disable the current.

Examples:
    red river s 300     [Current flows south every 75 seconds
                 (300 / 4 = 75)]
    red river e 0       [Disable the current in this room]

This will set up an automatic teleport in the current room.  It will send
a player to the destination room number specified in to_room after the time
has expired.  Time is measured in pulses (1/4 second) and starts counting
after the first time the player enters the room, seperately for each player
that enters.  If a player leaves, his counter is reset to 0 so his count will
start fresh the next time he enters.  Look_flag is either 0 or 1.  If set to
1, when the player is teleported he will automatically see the new room
description.  Setting this to 0 will make the player totally clueless as to
whether he was teleported or not.

is being teleported.

Examples:

Defines the maximum number of creatures passing through the room who's tracks

Remortalization is one of the unique features available on Perilous Realms.  Once
you achieve level 500 within the game, you have become the pinnacle of the
mortal realm.  Since you have reached mortal perfection and can not gain from
any further experience, you have the ability to exchange your experience for
a form of physical perfection.  When remortalized, your character will be taken
back to level 1.  All of your skills, spells, practice sessions are set back to
0, just as if your character was started anew.  However when you are taken back
to level 1, you are granted a perfect attribute of your choice.  As a bonus, to 
celebrate your first of many remorts, you will be granted two perfect attributes 
of your choice. When you accomplish making your mortal the example of perfection
both in the physical sense and with expertise, there will be new options and 
challenges for you to undertake.

Currently to remortalize, you must go to your alignment appropriate Cathedral in
Midgaard and type remort at the altar to see what options are available to you.  When 
you have made a selection, you need to buy the services at the altar.

As a note, you do not have to loose all of your equipment when you remortalize.
You have the option of depositing your equipment into the bank for safe keeping,
until you are able to meet the requirements of wearing it once again.  If you
are a member of a clan, or own your own home, you may also deposit it into a
storage locker for safe keeping.

Rogues are deadly but some some consider them vulnerable physical combatants. 
Their combat abilities are similar to those who focus more on their stealth
techniques and are proficient only in smaller quicker weapons. What advantages 
they have rely on high Dexterity,  which augments their armor class and missile 
weapon aim.  The bulk of their skills are also improved by better Dexterity or 
Intelligence. As such rogues should have high values in one or both of these 
attributes. Rogues are not typically intended to act as front-line soldiers, 
but are instead meant to flank enemies. There they use their unique abilities 
to inflict great injury to the enemy. A well built rogue is capable of s
urpassing many other classes in terms of melee-damage, when the rogue is able 
to gain a special advantage over a target.

As a paladin is a hybrid of fighter and cleric, sohei are a mix of mages, warriors, and 
thiefs.  Sohei's in dojos end up working for a temple or a monastery and performing 
whatever missions and duties are required of them. Unlike samurai and shugenja, sohei 
come to their paths from all social classes and backgrounds. Those who show a talent for

but excel at a contemplative bent make perfect sohei. Adventurer's often remark that sohei

Spam is the repeated use of a phrase, command, or channel that causes screen 
scroll for others.  Not only is spam considered rude, but excessive screen 
scroll can interfere with the game play of anyone seeing it (not to mention 
combat situations).
 
It is also considered spam to use the same phrase over several different
channels.  The use of all-caps can also be considered spam.  Only use
capitals to add emphasis to key words in a sentence.
 
Moving a large number of items into and out of a container in a crowded, 
non-store room is considered spam.  Making charmed mobs or pets to cause 
screen scroll through movement or orders is considered spam. ANYTHING that 
causes excessive or irritating screen scroll can be considered spam.

Spam is something that no one really likes, and can constitue harrassment
if focused on a player.  Harrassment is against the laws of the land and
may result in punishment from the administrative staff.

How spells work:
Spells do #d# * (your level+1 - spell learn lvl)  damage if its offensive.

Example: magic missile learnable at lvl 3 does: 1d4*1  if your lvl 3
 at lvl 4 it does 1d4*2 at 5,  1d4*3 and so on, the highest multiplier
 on most spells is 5.  So the highest magic missile can get is 1d4*5

These commands put you in various positions.  Some are more conducive to rest
while others increase your readiness for combat and movement.  You can only
move while in the STAND position, but your rate of recovery is rather slow.
To improve this rate, you can SIT, REST, and SLEEP with each increasing in
recovery potential respectively.  (SIT gives more recovery than STAND but not
as much as REST or SLEEP.)  The drawback is that attacks against you have a

The average troll stands nine feet high and weighs roughly 500 pounds, though 
females tend to be a bit larger than males. The hide of trolls is rubbery, and

somewhat shorter, due to their sagging shoulders and tendency to hunch forward.

gates and doors, but that same hulk reduces their agility.

An arena is a special area within the game in which Player Killing can take
place without the "cost" of loosing equipment or levels due to a death.

Every so often (pretty much at an immortals whim), an arena is run.  What this
means is that the immortal running it picks what levels he wants to participate,
and how much it will cost to get in, etc, and then the mortals are allowed to
kill each other, for a cash prize.  When an arena is started, a message will
be sent to all players telling them how to join, etc.

-- You loose nothing in the arena (other than spells/scrolls/wands you use). --

When you enter, you will be fully healed, and when you are dead, you will
be healed and whisked back to the fountain.  Your equipment will not
be damaged, however, if you use limited use items (potions, scrolls, wands,
etc), they will be used permanently.

To be notified of what is going on in the arena type CHANNEL SPORTS, typing it
again will turn it off.

You may NOT group in the arena!  If an immortal even suspects that grouping is
going on, whether literal or just an inappropriate amount of cooperation,
that immortal has free reign to do nasty things to you.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are also several "arena's" in Perilous Realms, in which mortals may
challenge one another at any time without immortal intervention.  These area's
have the same rules as an immortal run arena.  The only difference, is at a free
arena you are not healed upon your death, but are transfered back to the bounce
room.  Your equipment remains intacts, and you can not be looted in these mortal
"arena's".

#{bold}WHAT IS IT?#{o}
  
Players now have the option to remort almost indefinitely, creating unique
characters that have enhanced abilities, natural magical affects like true-
sight, super stats and extra hit points to name but a few.
  
Players can use their quest points, their apex points or sacrifice a life
(in the same manner as the current system). Sacrificing a life is sometimes
necessary to reach higher levels and avoid getting stuck completely.
  
#{bold}HOW DO YOU GET ACCESS TO IT?#{o}
  
To attain access to the Apex Remorting System, and to start earning Apex
points, a player must be fully Remorted (i.e. Remorted 6 times under the 
current system.) Following that players will receive APEX points when they
kill harder enemies.  Players will only gain Apex points if their level is
500 at the time of the kill.
  
#{bold}HOW DO YOU USE IT?#{o}
  
To use this new feature, get 6 remorts, gain 500 levels and go to your
regular remort altar and type 'remort'.  A whole new set of stats will be
available to choose from.

#{bold}ARE THERE ANY OTHER NEW COMMANDS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS?#{o}
  
Yes! New command: afflictions (aff)

damage based on the Barbarian's base stats, remort count, and the

Berserk is a Barbarian only skill that sends the barbarian in to a mindless
killing rage during combat.  During the rage the Barbarian outputs a greatly
increased amount of damage along with a bonus to a random attribute (players
are encouraged to work these bonus attributes out themselves).

This ability has two forms; passive and active:

1. Passive: The berserk can activate in any combat at any time when the
Barbarian sustains damage and scales proportionate to the amount of damage
the Barbarian is taking, the number of remorts the Barbarian has attained
and the base stats of the Barbarian.  Following a passive activation of
Berserk the Barbarian will experience no debuff effects or penalties.

2. Active: The berserk is activated by the Barbarian by entering the
command 'berserk'.  This rage will last longer than the passive
berserk but will also cause the barbarian to take more damage whilst
dealing more damage similar to the Passive effect. Scaling with the 
number of remorts the Barbarian has attained, and the base stats of the
Barbarian.  When the berserk is over the Barbarian will enter a cooldown
phase that will cause the Barbarian to become slower for a short duration.
During berserk recovery the passive berserk cannot activate.

In all cases, passive and active berserks cannot be entered if the Barbarian
is currently experiencing a cooldown effect from a previous Berserk or if a
Berserk (passive or active) is currently in progress.

The duration of a berserk is based upon level, remort count and the base stats
of the Barbarian.  Further, the debuff duration and effect also reduces with
the remort count and apex remort count.

text:
Socket is used to insert sockets into other items with free slots for them.
It can also be used to combine multiple sockets into an upgraded version,
or check information about what's currently socketed into an item. Finally
you can use it to destroy or remove an existing socket to free up room for
a better socket.

When a socket is inserted into an item the item gains additional stats as
described by the stats on the socket. If a socket is unique it means you
can only socket 1 of this gem into an item, you also cannot wear 2 items
with the same unique gem inserted into them.

Examine and identify now reveals if an item is either a socket and can be
inserted into another item, or if it has slots for sockets and how many.
-----
Insert a gem into an item with free socket slots:
socket insert <gem> <item>
socket insert emerald vulcan
-----
Combine several gems of the same type:
socket combine <gem>
socket combine emerald
-----
Display gem information and costs to remove gems on an item:
socket info <item>
socket info vulcan
-----
Destroy or remove a socket to free up a slot on an item:
- Examine the item and check the id next to the socket you want to destroy.
- [2] #{bold green}a flawless emerald#{o}
socket remove  <item> <id>
socket remove  vulcan 2
socket destroy <item> <id>
socket destroy vulcan 2

*** Removing a gem has a cost associated with it. The higher tier of the
    gem you remove, the more it costs. Very high tiers costs both apex
    points and gold to remove. Destroying a gem is free.
usage:
socket insert  <gem> <item>
socket combine <gem>
socket remove  <item> <id>
socket destroy <item> <id>
socket info    <item>
